node.title: Re: map() and grep() suppress "Can't use an undefined value as an ARRAY reference at ..." errors
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Haven't done a ton of research yet, but think the answer is the same as in [id://1203377]: map probably provides lvalue context to the list it is iterating over (because it allows modification of the original items of the list via $_), and autovivification happens in lvalue context. Further somewhat related reading:

  • [id://1208949]
  • [id://1201610]

Update: [stevieb] [id://1210996|beat me to it] :-)
